title: Getting started with cagedr
text: CAGED (Cadastro Geral de Empregados e Desempregados) monthly registry admissions separations formal workers Brazil, published Ministry Labour Employment. Since January 2020 series Novo CAGED, built eSocial declarations, public, non-identified microdata published PDET FTP server, one folder per reference month: file national: 55 MB compressed, 600 MB text 4 5 million records MOV file. Ministry publishes month around end following month occasionally re-publishes earlier months. cagedr three things files: lists reference months available server; downloads idempotent local cache; reads stream, filtering state selecting columns anything kept memory. third point makes package useful ordinary laptop: one state typically 2 3 % national file, never hold 97 % memory.
code: ftp://ftp.mtps.gov.br/pdet/microdados/NOVO CAGED/<AAAA>/<AAAAMM>/     CAGEDMOV<AAAAMM>.7z   movements declared on time     CAGEDFOR<AAAAMM>.7z   movements declared late (earlier reference months)     CAGEDEXC<AAAAMM>.7z   exclusions (cancelled movements)

title: Streaming, cache and data vintages
text: national CAGEDMOV archive expands roughly 600 MB text. Reading usual way (extract, read.csv) needs much disk multiple memory. caged_read() avoids : archive::archive_read() opens connection decompresses .txt fly, nothing written disk; readr::read_delim_chunked() parses connection chunks (500,000 lines default); callback filters chunk uf keeps requested columns chunk stored. Peak memory therefore one chunk national file plus rows keep. Reading Pernambuco (110,000 records) 4.5-million-record month takes 20 30 seconds laptop stays well 1 GB. need whole country, call caged_read() without uf. still streams, hold every record memory end, select columns.
code: library(cagedr) f <- system.file("extdata", "CAGEDMOV202301_sample.7z", package = "cagedr")  # Smaller chunks use less memory; the result is identical. a <- caged_read(f, chunk_size = 5, verbose = FALSE) b <- caged_read(f, verbose = FALSE) identical(a, b) #> [1] TRUE

title: Streaming, cache and data vintages

what: Vintages: why old months keep changing
title: Streaming, cache and data vintages
text: (late declarations) EXC (exclusions) archives month M contain records whose competenciamov earlier M: employer declares January admission April produces record CAGEDFOR202604 competenciamov = 202601. Ministry’s published balance January therefore revised every month, reproduce must read every archive published date want mimic. Two practical consequences: Aggregate competenciamov, never caged_period. caged_balance() . pipeline keeps consolidated table recompute archives monthly download, rather appending new month. Ministry also re-publishes whole months time time (folders several months share modification date server event). caged_available() returns date; moved month already , delete caged_cache_clear(period) download .
code: exc <- caged_read(system.file("extdata", "CAGEDEXC202301_sample.7z", package = "cagedr"),                   verbose = FALSE) # Exclusion records point to the month they cancel, not to the archive month table(archive = exc$caged_period, movement = exc$competenciamov) #>         movement #> archive  202108 202201 202208 202211 #>   202301      2      1      1      3

NULL keeps every state. files files download: subset c("MOV", "", "EXC"). columns Optional character vector columns keep, using normalized names listed caged_layout(). NULL keeps columns. uf column always read (needed filtering) returned requested columns NULL. cache_dir Optional cache directory (see caged_cache_dir()). force Re-download archives already cache? types Convert numeric columns layout (codes, salary) integer/double? FALSE every column returned character. chunk_size Number lines parsed per chunk. Larger chunks faster use memory; default (500,000 lines) uses well 1 GB. timeout Timeout seconds file. what: cagedr: Access Novo CAGED Microdata from the Brazilian Ministry of Labour — cagedr-package
title: cagedr: Access Novo CAGED Microdata from the Brazilian Ministry of Labour — cagedr-package
text: Download read public, non-identified microdata Novo CAGED (Cadastro Geral de Empregados e Desempregados), monthly registry formal employment movements published Brazilian Ministry Labour Employment PDET FTP server <ftp://ftp.mtps.gov.br/pdet/microdados/>. Lists reference months available server, downloads three monthly files (movements declared time, declared late, exclusions) idempotent local cache, reads national 7z archives stream, filtering state selecting columns anything kept memory, single state can extracted without loading full national file. Also provides official record layout helper consolidate admissions, separations net balance reference month.

title: cagedr 0.1.0
text: Initial release. caged_available() lists reference months published PDET/MTE FTP server, folder modification dates. caged_download() fetches MOV, EXC archives one months idempotent local cache (caged_cache_dir(), caged_cache_list(), caged_cache_clear()). caged_read() stream-reads national .7z archive, filtering state selecting columns chunk chunk, normalised column names typed codes; caged_fetch() combines download read several months. caged_balance() consolidates admissions, separations net balance competenciamov, inverting sign exclusion records. caged_layout() documents 30 columns official record layout. Sample archives inst/extdata allow every reading function tried offline.
